# Base64Encode

Encodes text as Base64.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Base64Encode(text)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to encode, taken as its UTF-8 bytes. Null is read as the empty string. A number, a boolean, an array, an object or a function is a runtime error: it is not read as its string form. Text that holds an unpaired surrogate is a runtime error, as is a result that would pass the host's maximum value size. |

## Returns

String. The Base64 text of the UTF-8 bytes of text, in the standard alphabet with `=` padding and no line breaks; the empty string for empty text. `Base64Decode` gives the text back. Never null.

## Example

`Base64Encode("Hello")` returns `"SGVsbG8="`.
